words.sense: Persistently gloomy, solemn, and slow to display warmth or enthusiasm.
misconceptions: Treating resentful refusal to speak as a settled temperament.
Ignoring whether the gloom persists across occasions.

words.sense: Gloomily resentful, often refusing to talk or cooperate because of displeasure.
misconceptions: Treating enduring solemnity as resentment over a grievance.
Ignoring whether the gloom persists across occasions.

semantic_axes.description: Saturnine describes a lasting gloomy disposition; sullen describes resentful withdrawal in response to displeasure.

edges.boundary_rule: Saturnine describes a lasting gloomy disposition; sullen describes resentful withdrawal in response to displeasure.

misconceptions.M1: Treating enduring solemnity as resentment over a grievance.
misconceptions.M2: Treating resentful refusal to speak as a settled temperament.
misconceptions.M3: Ignoring whether the gloom persists across occasions.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Pavel’s usual manner with relatives?

beats.text: At every gathering, Pavel spoke slowly, rarely smiled, and looked grave even when everyone else celebrated.
beats.decisive_clue: consistent grave manner across many celebrations
beats.reason: Consistent grave manner across many celebrations. Persistently gloomy, solemn, and slow to display warmth or enthusiasm.

beats.text: Even when relatives handed him birthday presents, he thanked them with the same grave expression.
beats.decisive_clue: receiving presents does not alter his settled grave expression
beats.reason: Receiving presents does not alter his settled grave expression. Persistently gloomy, solemn, and slow to display warmth or enthusiasm.

chains.feedback_short: Receiving presents does not alter his settled grave expression.
chains.feedback_deep: Saturnine means persistently gloomy, solemn, and slow to display warmth or enthusiasm; sullen means gloomily resentful, often refusing to talk or cooperate because of displeasure. Here, consistent grave manner across many celebrations. The new detail does not change the deciding fact: receiving presents does not alter his settled grave expression. Thus saturnine remains the stronger choice.
chains.contrast_rule: Saturnine is lasting gloom; sullen is gloom with a grievance.

hints.attention: Focus on whether this happens at just one gathering or repeatedly.
hints.axis: Saturnine describes a lasting gloomy disposition; sullen describes resentful withdrawal in response to displeasure.
hints.contrast: Saturnine is lasting gloom; sullen is gloom with a grievance.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Mei’s mood after the match?

beats.text: After the match, when her teammates rejected her plan, Mei folded her arms and refused to answer their questions.
beats.decisive_clue: resentful refusal to speak after her plan was rejected
beats.reason: Resentful refusal to speak after her plan was rejected indicates a sullen mood.

beats.text: She was wearing a bright yellow jersey.
beats.decisive_clue: the jersey’s colour does not alter her offended silence
beats.reason: The jersey’s colour does not alter her offended silence, so sullen remains the stronger choice.

chains.feedback_short: Her offended silence after the rejection is unchanged by her jersey’s colour.
chains.feedback_deep: Sullen describes gloomily resentful withdrawal after displeasure. Mei’s refusal to answer follows her teammates’ rejection of her plan, while the jersey’s colour is irrelevant. Saturnine describes a lasting gloomy disposition, which is not the decisive clue here.
chains.contrast_rule: Saturnine is lasting gloom; sullen is gloom with a grievance.

hints.attention: Focus on what caused her silence after the match.
hints.axis: Saturnine describes a lasting gloomy disposition; sullen describes resentful withdrawal in response to displeasure.
hints.contrast: Saturnine is lasting gloom; sullen is gloom with a grievance.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Sameer’s general expression at family events?

beats.text: Sameer attended every celebration with a grave expression and little interest in joining the laughter.
beats.reason: A grave manner repeated across celebrations indicates a saturnine disposition.

beats.text: Even when he received the job offer he had always wanted, his expression barely changed.
beats.decisive_clue: personal success does not change the settled gloomy manner
beats.reason: Personal success does not change the settled gloomy manner, reinforcing saturnine rather than sullen.

chains.feedback_short: His grave manner persists even after personal success.
chains.feedback_deep: Saturnine describes a persistently gloomy, solemn disposition. Sameer shows that manner across celebrations, and even welcome personal success barely changes his expression. Sullen would require a specific grievance or resentful withdrawal, which is not present.
chains.contrast_rule: Saturnine is lasting gloom; sullen is gloom with a grievance.

beats.reason: Silent resentment after losing a family decision. Gloomily resentful, often refusing to talk or cooperate because of displeasure.

beats.reason: Aggrieved silence directed at friends who excluded him. Gloomily resentful, often refusing to talk or cooperate because of displeasure.

beats.reason: A settled solemn manner across repeated enjoyable games. Persistently gloomy, solemn, and slow to display warmth or enthusiasm.

beats.text: She enjoyed being included and had no quarrel with anyone; her solemn manner was familiar to the whole family.
beats.decisive_clue: enjoyment without a quarrel points to temperament rather than resentment
